content_sections.heading: TNJFU Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University
Comparative performance evaluation of alternative formulations against control and market reference diets
Directorate of Incubation and Vocational Training in Aquaculture (DIVA), Muttukadu, Chennai
Purely temporary for a project period of six months only

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the essential educational qualification to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow post. Essential Qualification: M.F.Sc. (Fish Nutrition and Feed Technology / Aquaculture / Aquatic Animal Health Management and related disciplines). Desirable Skills: Candidate with strong knowledge and experience on conducting nutritional experiments, analysis of growth and immune related parameters. Candidate with good manuscript writing skills with relevant research publications with good impact factor. Necessary computer knowledge for documenting and analyzing scientific research data, statistical analysis is required. Candidate with knowledge on government procurement procedures. Salary : Rs.30,000/- PM

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNJFU Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Compile all necessary proof of documents in PDF format. Send the CV and documents via email to [email protected] on or before 16.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview will be conducted online with prior intimation.

faq.question: Q1. Is this TNJFU Junior Research Fellow post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is purely temporary and for the project period of six months only.

faq.question: Q2. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold an M.F.Sc. in Fish Nutrition and Feed Technology, Aquaculture, Aquatic Animal Health Management, or related disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for this post?
faq.answer: The monthly emolument is Rs. 30,000/- PM.

faq.question: Q4. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their detailed CV along with necessary proof of documents in PDF format via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 16.10.2026.
